question: Two persons A and B can do a work alone in 29 days. A takes the rest of one day after every 4 days and B takes the rest of one day after every 5 days. If A and B starts working together, then the work will be completed on ?
solution:
**Given:-**

(1) A and B can do work alone in 29 days.

(2) A takes the rest of one day after every 4 days and B takes the rest of one day after every 5 days 

**Formula used:- ** 

Work Done = Time Taken × Rate of Work. 

Time Taken = 1 / Rate of Work

**Calculation:-** 

 

A alone can do 1 / 29 of the work in 1 day

B alone can do 1 / 29 of the work in 1 day

A and B together can do 1 / 29+1 / 29=2 / 29 of the work in 1 day the first 4 days,

A and B together can do = 2 ×4over29 = 8 / 29 of the work in the first 4 days 

On the 5th day, B alone can do 1 / 29 of the work in 5th day

On the 6th day, A alone can do 1 / 29 of the work in 6th day

On 7,8 and 9th A and B together can do = 2×3over29 = 6 / 29 of the work in 3 days

On the 10th day, (rest day for A) B alone can do 1 / 29 of the work on 10th day

On 11th A and B together can do = 2 / 29 of the work on 11th day

On the 12th day, (rest day for B) A alone can do = 1 / 29 of the work on 12th day

Cumulative completion of work in 12 days = 8/29 + 1/29 + 1/29 + 6/29 + 1/29 + 2/29 + 1/29 = 20/29

On 13th and 14th A and B together can do = 4/29 of the work 1n 2 days

On the 15th day, (rest day for A) B alone can do 1/29 of the work on 15th day

On 16th and 17th A and B together can do = 4/29 of the work 1n 2 days

Cumulative completion of work in 17 days = 20/29 + 4/29 + 1/29 + 4/29 = 29/29 (fully completed)

** ∴The work will be completed on the __17th day__**
